title: Work view: Closed view, newest-closed first, paged through Engram's ls --closed
outcome: The Work panel offers a visible Closed view next to open work. It lists completed, cancelled and superseded items newest-closed first, using Engram's durable close order from `ls --closed` (Engram w-0623391b54ed), not list position. It pages incrementally like open work and shows each row's close kind and time. Greg's direction (Advisor b9d13887 #824, plan approved #826): this starts only after Engram's (B) lands.
acceptance: A visible Open/Closed switch selects the Closed view, which lists all terminal Engram work (completed, cancelled and superseded) from Engram `ls --closed` in ONE ordinary list, ordered by Engram's closed_at descending then stable id as Engram delivers it, each row showing its close time and close kind; the Open view is unchanged; UI tests show both.

The Closed view pages incrementally with the same mechanics as the open view (one request in flight, the Engram cursor and readerId guard, a visible 'list changed; reload' stop when the cursor is invalidated, distinct loading, end and error states with a single-request Retry); UI tests show them.

Records migrated during the old Beads cutover appear in the same list with no 'earlier history', 'inherited' or Beads label or section, and TermAl invents no ordering of its own; a test with such rows shows it.
`npx tsc --noEmit` is clean and the full five-stage gate passes on the exact landed input, against a pinned Engram build that implements `ls --closed`.

blockers.detail: Waits for Engram w-0623391b54ed (`ls --closed`) to land and for a pinned Engram build with it installed; Greg's direction is to start only after (B) lands. It should also build on w-270c4b1fa8bc's landed paging code.

disposal_reason: Superseded by Greg's simplification (Engram::Advisor, TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #833, 22:04Z): "Do NOT build a new closed-specific Engram API or a separate Closed-order UI surface... use the existing lifecycle data/filter and Updated sort to show closed work." Closed work is now covered by w-270c4b1fa8bc rev 3, criterion 3: closed work reachable through the existing lifecycle filter and ordered by Updated, with the full set fetched through `ls --all`. Its Engram dependency, w-0623391b54ed, was cancelled by Engram::Fable as unneeded scope (ebe242f7 #2194). If the --all payload lacks a needed field, Engram will revive a minimal API under a new item. (Termal::Fable2, coordinator)
